daily.today_energy: Your mind is buzzing with fresh ideas today, Gemini. There's a restless, creative energy asking you to explore something new—whether that's a hobby, conversation, or perspective shift. Trust the momentum.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, your words have extra magic right now. For singles, someone's noticing your wit and charm. Either way, authenticity is your biggest turn-on today. Be unapologetically you.
daily.career: Your communication skills are peak today. This is the moment to pitch ideas, have difficult conversations, or collaborate. The universe is backing your voice—use it wisely and watch doors open.
daily.health: Your nervous system might feel activated, which isn't bad—it's just energy asking for movement. Consider a walk, stretching, or anything that lets your body match your spirited mind.

weekly.overview: Mercury's dancing through your sector of reinvention this week, Gemini. You're picking up on energies others are missing—trust those intuitive hits. This is your moment to lean into what actually lights you up instead of what looks good on paper.
weekly.love: Venus is giving soft, curious energy. Whether you're coupled or single, this week invites deeper conversations that go beyond surface level. Someone might surprise you with how much they actually get you. Let yourself be a little vulnerable.
weekly.career: Your ideas are genuinely valuable rn, but the real magic is in how you communicate them. This week rewards bold clarity over overthinking. Pitch that thing you've been sitting on—the timing is weirdly perfect for getting heard.
weekly.health: Your nervous system might feel a bit activated mid-week, so create pockets of calm where you can. Movement that feels grounding (think walks, yoga) hits different than usual intensity. Listen to what your body's actually asking for.
